title: Model Jigsaw
description: Rotate and assemble charming miniature 3D models piece by piece, snapping each sculpted part cleanly into its slot to bring tiny dioramas to life.
controls: Drag sculpted model parts from the tray onto their matching slots on the miniature diorama until every piece clicks into place.

zh-CN.title: 模型拼图
zh-CN.description: 治愈系精致立体模型组装：把零散的微缩模型零件逐一拼装归位，亲手还原一座座色彩明快的立体小景。
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动模型零件放到对应的模型槽位中，全部拼合到位即可完成作品。
